answer: A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the sonnet queue naming the vine that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every alias costs 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the violet record reveals exactly who is still on probation. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
